snippet.title: Hole Is Mine Teaser
snippet.description:
Hole Is Mine is an incremental adventure about purifying the Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'ohs with incredible powers. The Hole has spoken!

Wishlisht now on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4508020/Hole_Is_Mine/
